title: Hong Kong Sovereignty Transition Strategy
description: Managed transfer of Hong Kong sovereignty from British to Chinese administration
purpose: Ensure peaceful, orderly transition while preserving British interests and Hong Kong stability
objectives: Complete sovereignty transfer by 1997, preserve One Country Two Systems, maintain British influence
keyActivities: Treaty negotiation, legal framework development, transition planning, stakeholder management
keyPerformanceIndicators: Peaceful transition, economic stability, international recognition
